exports.signature: (text: string): string[][]
exports.documentation:
Parse RFC-4180-style CSV into a grid of raw strings: comma-delimited, with
`"`-quoted fields that may embed commas, newlines, and doubled quotes, plus
CR / LF / CRLF row breaks. A leading UTF-8 BOM is stripped. This mirrors

exports.signature: (raw: string): number | null
exports.documentation:
Parse a currency-formatted string into a plain number, or `null` when the
remaining text is not numeric. Strips currency symbols (`$ € £ ¥ ¤`), thousands
grouping (`,`), and whitespace, and reads accounting-style parentheses
(`(1,234.50)`) as a negative amount. Grouping/decimals follow the US locale the
renderer uses.

exports.name: parseDateInput
exports.signature: (raw: string): number | null
exports.documentation:
Parse a user-typed date string into a serial, or `null` when it is not a date.
Accepted forms:

- ISO `yyyy-mm-dd` (e.g. `2026-07-06`);
- ISO date-time `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm` or `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` (a `T` separator is
  also accepted); the fractional serial carries the time;
- slash `dd/mm/yyyy` and `mm/dd/yyyy`, disambiguated **conservatively**: if one
  component exceeds 12 it must be the day and the layout is unambiguous; when
  both are ≤ 12 the value is ambiguous (e.g. `04/05/2026`) and is read as
  **mm/dd** — Google Sheets' default (US) locale. Both > 12 is rejected.

Anything else (bare numbers, free text) returns `null` so callers can fall back
to a text literal.

exports.name: createGridController
exports.signature: (host: HTMLElement, options: GridOptions, handlers: GridControllerHandlers): GridController
exports.documentation:
Create a grid and wire its lifecycle once, so the React/Vue/Svelte adapters
(and any plain host) share a single, drift-free implementation instead of
each re-deriving the same create → subscribe → teardown behavior.

`initSheetwrite()` MUST already have been awaited; {@link createGrid} throws
otherwise.

### Live handlers
`handlers` is held **by reference**, not copied. Every event reads the
object's *current* fields (`handlers.onGridChange?.(…)`), so a host swaps
callbacks across renders by **mutating the fields of the same object** it
passed in — never by replacing the object, which the controller would not
see. This is what lets a framework feed fresh closures each render without
tearing the grid down and rebuilding it.

bypass Grid history and policy.

worker constructed successfully, `"canvas"` otherwise (including after a

memberDocs.documentation:
Replace every current match in a single undoable transaction (one
`undo()` restores them all), then re-scan. Formula/ref cells are skipped
and not counted. No-op when read-only.

memberDocs.name: replaceCurrent
memberDocs.documentation:
Replace the active match with `replacement`, then advance to the next match
(re-scanning against the new data). Only literal text/number cells are
eligible; formula and ref cells are skipped (formula source is never
rewritten). Honors the active {@link SearchOptions} (matchCase; `wholeCell`
swaps the entire cell). The write flows through the grid's commit path as
one undoable step. No-op when read-only or when there is no active match.

(`DEFAULT_THEME < CSS custom properties < theme`) with the new partial.

{@link setTheme}.

memberDocs.documentation:

(re-scanning against the new data). Only literal text/number cells are

memberDocs.name: rendererKind
memberDocs.documentation:
Which renderer is actually active: `"worker"` when the OffscreenCanvas
worker constructed successfully, `"canvas"` otherwise (including after a
`renderer-fallback`).

memberDocs.name: replaceAll
memberDocs.documentation:
Replace every current match in a single undoable transaction (one
`undo()` restores them all), then re-scan. Formula/ref cells are skipped
and not counted. No-op when read-only.

memberDocs.name: replaceCurrent
memberDocs.documentation:
Replace the active match with `replacement`, then advance to the next match
(re-scanning against the new data). Only literal text/number cells are
eligible; formula and ref cells are skipped (formula source is never
rewritten). Honors the active {@link SearchOptions} (matchCase; `wholeCell`
swaps the entire cell). The write flows through the grid's commit path as
one undoable step. No-op when read-only or when there is no active match.

memberDocs.name: replaceTheme
memberDocs.documentation:
Option-level replacement: re-run construction-time resolution
(`DEFAULT_THEME < CSS custom properties < theme`) with the new partial.
`undefined` restores the CSS-variable/default resolution. Adapters call
this for their declarative `theme` prop; imperative patching stays on
{@link setTheme}.

memberDocs.name: rowGroups
memberDocs.documentation: Row groups on the active sheet.

memberDocs.name: search
memberDocs.documentation: Find cells matching `query`; highlights matches, emits `search`, returns the result.

memberDocs.name: setColumnFilter
memberDocs.documentation:
Set or clear (null) one column's filter. All column filters AND together
and compose with the active sort and hidden rows.

memberDocs.name: setColumnWidth
memberDocs.documentation: Set one column's width via an undoable `setColumn` patch.

memberDocs.name: setConfig
memberDocs.documentation:
Reconfigure built-in chrome and keyboard handling without replacing the
Grid or clearing selection/history. Construction-bound GridOptions are not
accepted here.

memberDocs.name: setFrozen
memberDocs.documentation:
Pin the first `rows` view rows and `cols` columns; they stay visible while
the body scrolls (0 = unfreeze that axis). Persisted on the active sheet.

memberDocs.name: setGroupCollapsed
memberDocs.documentation: Collapse/expand a row group; collapsing hides its rows.

memberDocs.name: setMinColumns
memberDocs.documentation:
Live-update the minimum rendered column count. Increasing the minimum
silently extends presentation padding; `undefined` restores the default.

memberDocs.name: setOverscan
memberDocs.documentation:
Live-update the render window overscan (rows/cols painted beyond the
viewport); `undefined` restores the default.

memberDocs.name: setPresenceOverlays
memberDocs.documentation: Replace ephemeral remote-presence overlays; null clears every collaborator.

memberDocs.name: setReadOnly
memberDocs.documentation: Update editability without replacing the Grid or clearing session state.

memberDocs.name: setRowHeight
memberDocs.documentation: Set one row's persistent display height through document history.

memberDocs.name: setSort
memberDocs.documentation: Persisted multi-key sort of the active sheet.

memberDocs.name: setTheme
memberDocs.documentation: Imperative patch: merge `theme` into the accumulated base theme.

memberDocs.name: setZoom
memberDocs.documentation: Content zoom factor (0.5–2): scales row/column geometry and fonts.

memberDocs.name: showColumns
memberDocs.documentation: Show columns through one bulk-safe metadata transaction.

memberDocs.name: showRows
memberDocs.documentation: Show the given data rows again, or every hidden row when omitted.

memberDocs.name: sortBy
memberDocs.documentation: Sort the displayed rows by a column (does not mutate stored data).

memberDocs.name: sortByMulti
memberDocs.documentation: Multi-key sort of the displayed rows (first key primary; stable).

memberDocs.name: styleRange
memberDocs.documentation:
Merge `style` into every cell of `range` (null clears cell styles) as one
undoable transaction. Styles land in the store and paint in the canvas —
unlike {@link highlightCells}, which draws a translucent overlay above it.

memberDocs.name: undo
memberDocs.documentation: Undo the last recorded cell edit.

memberDocs.name: ungroupRows
memberDocs.documentation: Remove a row group (rows become visible if the group was collapsed).

memberDocs.documentation: Allocate a logical sheet whose cell chunks materialize on page load or edit.

memberDocs.name: aggregate
memberDocs.documentation: Column aggregate over numeric cells. op: 0 sum, 1 avg, 2 min, 3 max, 4 count.

memberDocs.name: captureRange
memberDocs.documentation: Capture a dense rectangle into an opaque store-local history resource.

memberDocs.name: cellState
memberDocs.documentation: 0 unloaded, 1 loaded-empty, 2 loaded-value, 3 dirty local edit.

memberDocs.name: clearRange
memberDocs.documentation: Clear a rectangle while independently controlling contents and style.

memberDocs.name: dataEdge
memberDocs.documentation:
Ctrl+Arrow destination: from `(row, col)` stepping by `(d_row, d_col)`
(exactly one of them ±1), return the destination row (vertical moves) or
column (horizontal moves), Google Sheets semantics:

- current and adjacent cell non-empty → end of the contiguous non-empty
  run;
- otherwise → the next non-empty cell in that direction;
- nothing ahead → the sheet edge.

memberDocs.name: filterRows
memberDocs.documentation: Data-row indices whose column text contains `needle` (case-insensitive).

memberDocs.name: getCell
memberDocs.documentation: Single-cell read for interactions/tests — never the render hot path.

memberDocs.name: getWindow
memberDocs.documentation:
One bulk read of a rectangular window for the renderer. Returns
contiguous typed arrays (row-major over `rows x cols`) plus the unique
strings referenced by the window, so the host paints without crossing
the boundary per cell.

memberDocs.name: getWindowRows
memberDocs.documentation:
Bulk read of an explicit row list (sorted/filtered views) — same output
shape as `get_window`, rows taken from `rows` rather than a range.

memberDocs.name: pagedStats
memberDocs.documentation: `[chunks, loaded cells, dirty cells, allocated bytes, fully loaded]`.

memberDocs.name: queryResourceStats
memberDocs.documentation: `[contains cache constructions, owned distinct strings]`.

memberDocs.name: rangeStyleIds
memberDocs.documentation: Unique style ids present in a rectangle; cost stays inside WASM.

memberDocs.name: recompute
memberDocs.documentation:
Recompute formulas affected by cells changed since the last call.

The pass first grows the dirty cell set through formula read-sets to find
all dependent formulas. It then evaluates only those formulas, using a
per-pass memo table so each formula cell is evaluated at most once even
when many downstream formulas reference it.

memberDocs.name: recomputeVolatile
memberDocs.documentation:
Explicit volatile barrier. `serial` is a UTC spreadsheet serial using
the 1899-12-30 epoch; only TODAY/NOW formulas and their dependents dirty.

memberDocs.name: remapRangeStyles
memberDocs.documentation: Remap styles over a rectangle using parallel old/new id tables.

memberDocs.name: removeSheet
memberDocs.documentation: Tombstone a stable sheet handle and invalidate every formula reference to it.

memberDocs.name: renameSheet
memberDocs.documentation: Rename a live stable sheet handle and rewrite every resolved formula AST reference.

memberDocs.name: restoreRange
memberDocs.documentation: Restore a captured block at a destination of the same dimensions.

memberDocs.name: search
memberDocs.documentation:
Cell coordinates whose text matches `query`, as a flat `[row, col, ...]`
list. Scans the requested columns column-major (cache-local), then sorts
row-major so search navigation runs top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

memberDocs.name: setBlock
memberDocs.documentation:
Write one row-major typed block in a single boundary call. `kinds` uses
0 empty / 1 number / 2 string; formulas and references are sparse host
exceptions applied after this literal bulk write.

memberDocs.name: setColumnNumbers
memberDocs.documentation: Bulk-load one column with numbers starting at `start_row`.

memberDocs.name: setColumnStrings
memberDocs.documentation: Bulk-load one column with strings starting at `start_row`.

memberDocs.name: setColumnStringsPacked
memberDocs.documentation:
Bulk-load one column of strings from a single concatenated buffer plus
per-row lengths in UTF-16 code units (the JS `string.length` unit).
One boundary decode and one Rust allocation for the whole column,
instead of one per row — the dominant ingest cost for text columns.

memberDocs.name: setConditionalRules
memberDocs.documentation:
Replace a sheet's conditional-format rules. Packed columnar encoding,
one entry per rule: `kinds` 0 gt / 1 lt / 2 eqNum / 3 eqStr / 4 eqEmpty /
5 contains; `bounds` = normalized `[r0, c0, r1, c1]` per rule; `nums`
carries the numeric operand; `strs` the text operand; `flags` bit 0 =
match-case for `contains`. Case-insensitive needles are lowercased here
once so the per-cell match never allocates.

memberDocs.name: setFormula
memberDocs.documentation:
Parse and store an arithmetic formula at `(row, col)`.

Setters only mark cells dirty; they do not recompute formulas. The host
calls `recompute(sheet)` once at the transaction barrier so a multi-cell
edit performs one dependency-scoped pass instead of one full-sheet pass
per setter. The returned value is the previous cached value until that
barrier recompute runs, and the store facade ignores it for batched edits.

memberDocs.name: sortRows
memberDocs.documentation: Stable row order sorted by a column. Returns a data-row permutation.

memberDocs.name: styleIdAt
memberDocs.documentation:
Current style-dictionary id at a cell; `0` when out of bounds. Used by
the host to write derived (reference-shadow) values without disturbing
the cell's style.

memberDocs.name: takeTexts

exports.name: load
exports.signature: (source?: BufferSource | URL | string | Request | WebAssembly.Module): Promise<void>
exports.documentation:
Initialize the WASM module. Idempotent and re-entrant: concurrent
same-source callers share one in-flight init; a concurrent different-source
call rejects; a different-source call after success warns and no-ops; a
rejected init is retryable. When `source` is omitted the loader picks the
right strategy for the runtime.

Opaque, store-local history payload for one dense rectangular cell block.

part of the serialized document protocol. String payloads remain interned in

memberDocs.name: takeNumbers
memberDocs.documentation: Consume and return per-cell numeric payloads (valid where kind == 1).

memberDocs.name: takeStringIds
memberDocs.documentation: Consume and return per-cell GLOBAL string-pool ids; `u32::MAX` means none.

memberDocs.name: takeStringIndex
memberDocs.documentation: Consume and return per-cell indices into `strings` (string cells only).

memberDocs.name: takeStrings
memberDocs.documentation: Consume and return unique strings referenced by this window.

memberDocs.name: takeStyleDict
memberDocs.documentation:
Consume and return the unique global style-dictionary ids referenced by
this window, in local-index order; the host maps each to a `CellStyle`.
